description: This is a PHP unit test class for the LanguageAPI in the OrangeHRM HRM system, specifically testing REST API endpoints related to language management. It includes setup methods and data-driven tests for getting all languages, getting one language, creating, updating, and deleting language records.

classes.name: LanguageAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the LanguageAPI REST API, testing various CRUD operations with data providers

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data by truncating language-related tables and populating fixtures from a YAML file.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all language records via the API with provided test case parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'getAll' API endpoint, reading from a YAML file.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single language record by ID via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for 'getOne' API endpoint.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new language record through the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for 'create' API endpoint.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing language record via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for 'update' API endpoint.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a language record via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestDelete
methods.description: Provides test cases for 'delete' API endpoint.
